summary: Implemented `rotate` (new logkeep/rotate.py and logkeep/policy.py, plus time parsing in dates.py and the subcommand in cli.py) following docs/rotate.md and docs/policy.md, and checked it on a copy of /app/data. 10 of the 11 unit tests pass; tests.test_rotate.RotateTest.test_dated_name_uses_the_offset_day_and_the_next_count fails because it expects the new dated archive to be named `.4` (highest K + 1), while rotate.md section 4 (OPS-4471) says K is the lowest unused number from 2 (`.2`); I followed the docs and left the test unchanged.
